text: In 2021-05 we spoke most as one around "commission to investigate the," 15 of us at peak on 2021-05-19, a phrase first said on 2017-02-14 by Nancy Pelosi. The same count, 15, aligned on "covid-19 hate crimes act" on 2021-05-18, first said on 2021-03-11 by Grace Meng. Fourteen of us said "under the american rescue plan," first said by Joyce Beatty. Fourteen of us said "facing hunger homelessness," and thirteen extended it to "students who are facing hunger homelessness" and "are facing hunger homelessness and other," both first said on 2021-05-11 by Alma S. Adams. Fourteen of us said "colleges and universities" and "at least half of the." That is the record of this era: a commission, an act, a plan, and students, each carried by fourteen or fifteen of us on a single day.
